title: Korea Tax Refund: Claim It At The Airport
summary: Claim your Korea tax refund in the right order, from the airport kiosk to collecting your money. Learn what to bring and how much you can expect back.

slides.title: Claim In The Right Order
slides.voice: Korea airport refunds are easy to miss. Claim in order.

slides.title: Before You Check Bags
slides.voice: Before check-in, scan your passport and receipts. If customs requests the goods, show them before checking your bags.

slides.title: Bring These To The Shop
slides.sub: Physical passport; unused goods; 15,000 won minimum
slides.voice: Keep goods unused; carry your physical passport. One participating-shop purchase must reach fifteen thousand won.
slides.photo_query: South Korea passport tax free shopping

slides.title: Collect After Security
slides.sub: Airside kiosk or desk; about 3–8% back
slides.voice: After passport control, collect at an airside kiosk or desk. Expect roughly three to eight percent back.
